# LeaseIQ Pro

> Deterministic lease finance MCP server for AI agents. Excel-verified commercial equipment lease math, reverse solvers, amortization schedules, and consumer auto lease/loan calculations.

## Links

- Marketplace: https://mcpize.com/mcp/leaseiq-pro
- MCP endpoint: https://leaseiq-pro.mcpize.run/mcp
- Product: https://leaseiqpro.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/glennl201/LeaseIQPro
- Install guide: https://github.com/glennl201/LeaseIQPro/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Tool reference: https://github.com/glennl201/LeaseIQPro/blob/main/docs/tools.md
- Agent card: https://github.com/glennl201/LeaseIQPro/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Pricing config: https://github.com/glennl201/LeaseIQPro/blob/main/mcpize.yaml

## Tools

- `calculate_lease` — commercial equipment lease payment (level, balloon, step, skip, IO, custom)
- `solve_lease_structure` — reverse solve Rate, Term, ResidualValue, PresentValue, Commission
- `generate_amortization_schedule` — full period schedule with interest/principal splits
- `calculate_auto_lease` — money factor, residual, tax methods, MSD, zero drive-off
- `calculate_auto_loan` — auto loan payment and lease-vs-buy totals

## Access

- Free Trial: 50 calls/month at https://mcpize.com/mcp/leaseiq-pro (no credit card)
- x402 pay-per-call: USDC on Base, $0.01–$0.10 per tool (HTTP 402 challenge)
- Professional: $19/month (1000 calls included)
